{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.00

|descr= Get a vehicle's inventory lock state. Can also be used on a unit's backback (see [[lockInventory]]).

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>private _isInventoryLocked = lockedInventory vehicle player;</sqf>
